prompt: Which choice conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: Walking along the shore, the student noticed a flock of pelicans diving for fish.
Walking along the shore, a flock of pelicans diving for fish was noticed by the student's eyes.
Walking along the shore, pelicans were diving for fish near the student.
Having walked along the shore, the pelicans dove near the student.
answer: Walking along the shore, the student noticed a flock of pelicans diving for fish.

wrong.Walking along the shore, a flock of peli: 開頭的 Walking 應該是人在走路，但逗號後的主詞變成 a flock of pelicans，形成懸垂修飾語；後面的被動句也很累贅。
wrong.Walking along the shore, pelicans were d: 主詞 pelicans 不可能是 walking 的人，修飾語錯接到鵜鶘，意思變成鵜鶘在岸邊走路。
wrong.Having walked along the shore, the pelic: Having walked 的動作者仍然被接到 pelicans，同樣是懸垂修飾語，而且鵜鶘走路與原意不符。

why: 句首的分詞片語必須修飾緊接在逗號後的主詞；走路的是 the student，所以主詞要放 the student。
tip: 句首分詞片語，動作者要是逗號後的主詞。
say: Walking along the shore, the student noticed a flock of pelicans diving for fish.

prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
text: Having studied the soil samples for three weeks, _____ finally announced the results.
options: the geologist
the results were
the soil samples
a report

wrong.the results were: Having studied 的動作者必須是人，the results 沒辦法研究土壤；而且 were 後面還缺少 announced 的語意。
wrong.the soil samples: 土壤樣本是被研究的對象，不是研究者，放在這裡會讓修飾語錯接。
wrong.a report: 報告無法自己研究樣本，句首分詞片語的動作者錯誤。

why: Having studied 是人才能做的動作，後面的主詞必須是能研究樣本的 the geologist。
tip: 先問：句首的動作是誰做的？
say: Having studied the soil samples for three weeks, the geologist finally announced the results.

prompt: 你要修改這句話：「Written in just two days, the critics praised the novel.」哪一個改法最能避免修飾語錯誤？
options: Written in just two days, the novel was praised by the critics.
Written in just two days, the critics praised the novel.
The critics, written in just two days, praised the novel.
Writing in just two days, the novel was praised by the critics.
answer: Written in just two days, the novel was praised by the critics.

wrong.Written in just two days, the critics pr: 這是原句，written 描述的是小說，但逗號後的主詞是評論家，變成評論家是兩天寫成的。
wrong.The critics, written in just two days, p: written 被直接放到 critics 旁邊，意思變成評論家被寫出來，依然錯誤。
wrong.Writing in just two days, the novel was: Writing 是主動語態，意思變成小說自己在寫作，應用被動的 written。

why: 被寫成的是小說，所以主詞要換成 the novel，並用被動語態搭配 written。
tip: 被修飾的名詞要緊接在逗號後面。
say: Written in just two days, the novel was praised by the critics.

prompt: 依據句子結構，下列哪一句真正表示「是經理在等電梯」？
options: While waiting for the elevator, the manager checked her messages.
While waiting for the elevator, the messages were checked by the manager's phone.
While waiting for the elevator, her messages showed new updates.
While the elevator waited, the manager's messages came in.
answer: While waiting for the elevator, the manager checked her messages.

wrong.While waiting for the elevator, the mess: 逗號後的主詞是 the messages，變成訊息在等電梯，修飾語錯接。
wrong.While waiting for the elevator, her mess: 主詞是 her messages，訊息不會等電梯，這是懸垂修飾語。
wrong.While the elevator waited, the manager's: 這句把等待的動作改成電梯在等，意思已經不是經理在等電梯。

why: While waiting 的主詞要和主要子句主詞一致，只有 the manager 能等電梯。
tip: While waiting 的主詞，要和主句主詞相同。
say: While waiting for the elevator, the manager checked her messages.

prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
text: Unlike the earlier model, which relied on manual data entry, _____ automatically records every measurement.
options: the new software
the new software's design
the earlier model's users
manual data entry

wrong.the new software's design: Unlike the earlier model 要比較的是同類事物，model 與 design 不對等，而且 design 不能自己記錄資料。
wrong.the earlier model's users: 這句話本來要比較新舊系統，users 是人，比較對象不一致。
wrong.manual data entry: 手動輸入是舊方法，不會自動記錄，語意矛盾。

why: Unlike 的比較對象要對等：舊的 model 對新的 software，且能自動記錄的是軟體。
tip: Unlike 前後要比較同類事物。
say: Unlike the earlier model, which relied on manual data entry, the new software automatically records every measurement.

prompt: Which choice conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: Exhausted after the long hike, the hikers fell asleep before dinner.
Exhausted after the long hike, dinner was skipped before the hikers fell asleep.
Exhausted after the long hike, the tent was where the hikers slept.
Being exhausted after the long hike, sleep came to the hikers quickly.
answer: Exhausted after the long hike, the hikers fell asleep before dinner.

wrong.Exhausted after the long hike, dinner wa: Exhausted 形容的是人，但逗號後的主詞變成 dinner，晚餐不可能感到疲累。
wrong.Exhausted after the long hike, the tent: 主詞是 the tent，帳篷不會疲累，修飾語錯接，句子也比較冗長。
wrong.Being exhausted after the long hike, sle: 主詞是 sleep，睡眠不會疲累，仍是懸垂修飾語。

why: Exhausted 要修飾感到疲累的人，所以逗號後的主詞要是 the hikers。
tip: 形容感受的修飾語，後面主詞要是人。
say: Exhausted after the long hike, the hikers fell asleep before dinner.

prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
text: Hoping to improve her reading speed, _____ every morning.
options: Marisol practiced timed passages
timed passages were practiced by Marisol
a daily schedule helped Marisol practice
the practice of timed passages happened

wrong.timed passages were practiced by Marisol: Hoping 的人是 Marisol，但句子主詞變成 timed passages，段落不會抱著希望，形成懸垂修飾語。
wrong.a daily schedule helped Marisol practice: 主詞是 a daily schedule，時間表不會抱持希望。
wrong.the practice of timed passages happened: 主詞 the practice 不是有希望的人，而且句子語意很空洞。

why: Hoping to improve her reading speed 描述的是人，所以主詞要直接是 Marisol。
tip: 表示希望或目的的片語，主詞要是人。
say: Hoping to improve her reading speed, Marisol practiced timed passages every morning.
